data.name: Sumitra
data.gender_notes: Sumitra is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit su, 'good', + mitra, 'friend' — 'good friend'. Its root is Sanskrit su + mitra. Sumitra, mother of Lakshmana in the Ramayana. Sumitra is a Sanskrit name meaning “Good friend; well-measured”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sumitra expresses “Good friend; well-measured”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit su, 'good', + mitra, 'friend' — 'good friend'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sumitra total 29, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.

vedic_reference.note: Sumitra is the name of a famous character in Indian epics like Mahabharata and Ramayana. She is the wife of Krishna in the Mahabharata and the mother of Lakshmana in Ramayana. Sumitra is also a common name in India.
